title: The plain vertical wheel always scrolls the positioned axis sideways
foundBy: repository owner, using a consuming timeline page: "swiping left/right or up/down both scroll the lanes left/right. I thought up/down would scroll the page?"
details:
In the positioned layout a plain vertical wheel scrolls the axis sideways, and only where the axis can move no further is the wheel left to the page. A page with a tall timeline inside a longer document met it as a trap. A reader scrolling down the page finds the lanes sliding sideways instead, until the axis hits its end. A horizontal swipe already scrolls the axis, so the vertical wheel is not the only way to move it.

A page should be able to leave the vertical wheel to the page, as `wheelZoom` lets it leave the Ctrl wheel to the browser. The default stays as it is, since the preview and the tracer's strip rely on it.
